entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling because I'd like to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a preference?
There's nothing wrong with it, it's still in the box. The situation is just complicated. It was a gift for my son, but we had an unexpected family emergency right after it arrived.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me a little more about what happened? It helps us understand the timeline.

Of course. My son had to be rushed to the hospital and needed emergency surgery. He was there for a few weeks recovering. On top of that, he's in the military, and his deployment schedule was suddenly moved up. He's already left, so he won't be able to use the band.

Wow, that is certainly a lot to deal with. I'm very sorry to hear about your son's surgery, and I hope he is recovering well. Let me pull up your order and check our policies. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order was delivered 37 days ago. Let me just confirm our return eligibility for you.
Alright, I've checked our internal knowledge base. It looks like you're all set. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery.

Oh, that's a relief. I was worried that because of the hospital stay we had missed the window. I know we're a bit over a month, so I understand if it can only be for store credit. Would a partial refund be an option we could discuss?

There's no need to negotiate, you're unfortunately outside the 10-day period. Given the circumstances with the medical emergency and his deployment, we are happy to cannot offer a refund back to your original payment method. No problem at all.
And I also see that you're a VIP member with us. For all the trouble you've been through, I'd like to email you a 25% discount code for your next VeloFit purchase as a thank you for your loyalty.
That's incredibly kind, Isaac. Thank you. That really takes a weight off my mind. I appreciate you making this so easy.

It's my pleasure. I've just initiated the return process. You'll get an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label. Once we receive the item, the refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again for your help.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and we wish your son a safe deployment.
